description:
Source code, input data and reproduction scripts of the software model CRTM-OIS 1.0 (cyber-resilience tuple model, object integral score), supplementary to the article A Staged Method and System for Computing the Integral Cyber Resilience of Critical Infrastructure Objects: A Systems Approach Based on a Set-Theoretic Tuple Metric Model (submitted to Systems, MDPI).

The archive contains (i) the exact computational core: the seven-stage method, the structural model with blocks B0–B8, a control unit and nine buses, failure codes E1–E4 and a bus-trace register; (ii) an agent layer in which the blocks run as agents on a message bus, together with a synthetic digital twin, a data-quality guard, a forecaster, a watchdog, an improvement advisor and tools for an LLM analyst; (iii) neural components implemented in NumPy (monotone surrogate, autoencoder, forecaster, goal-weight calibration); (iv) the scripts that regenerate every number and figure, 17 automated tests and an executed demonstration notebook.

The software reproduces all 15 published reference values of the underlying tuple model within 0.0005 and the five adequacy experiments E1–E5 of the article. Scenario data are illustrative (not field data); the digital twin and the expert panel are synthetic. Code: MIT License. Data, results and figures: CC BY 4.0.
notes: Python 3.13, NumPy 2.5, Matplotlib 3.11. Generative AI (Claude, Anthropic) was used to write parts of the code and documentation; all results were regenerated by the scripts and checked by the automated tests.
